name: ship-mod
description: Pull requests and deploys in Claude Code: a line above the prompt while CI runs, a check fails or a deploy is under way, a toast when one ends, and /ship for the list.

days.title: Days
days.description: Pull requests and failed deploys older than this many days are left out. 2 by default.

failedHours.title: Failed fades after
failedHours.description: Hours after which a failed pull request leaves the panel. 24 by default.

pollSeconds.title: Poll interval
pollSeconds.description: Seconds between pulls. 30 by default; 10 at the least.

golemUrl.title: golem URL
golemUrl.description: Where golem runs. The mod pulls deploy notices from GET /notices.

keychainService.title: Keychain service
keychainService.description: The macOS keychain item that holds the golem token. The token never leaves memory.
